'''Bandor's Palace''' was located on [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor (Moff)|Bandor]] had it designed in the style of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and it resembled the graceful spires of [[Palpatine/Legends|the Emperor's]] [[Imperial Palace/Legends|palace]], albeit on a small scale.
